name: Statistics
notes: Students must achieve an overall grade of C or better in the courses used for the minor.
At least four of the five courses must be STAT-listed - so at most one CSC substitution.

requirementGroups.label: Introductory statistics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The minor in statistics requires five courses in statistics: STAT 180 (formerly STAT 212), STAT 190 (formerly STAT 213), or equivalent

requirementGroups.label: Statistical computing
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: STAT 275, STAT 276, or STAT 277 (CSC 171 or CSC 172 may be permitted with advisor permission)
requirementGroups.note: CSC 171 or CSC 172 need advisor permission.
